title: PROMO-01 — product-scraper.ts: Browser Use CLI extracts ProductData from marketplace URLs
rationale: TICKET-008 P1-PROMO Sprint 1/5. SPRINT-508-BROWSER-01 done (browser-use installed in .venv-browser-use). Scrapes Amazon/Etsy/Shopify/Product Hunt URLs via Browser Use AI agent. Outputs ProductData JSON to workspace/promo-jobs/{jobId}/product.json. Gate: 3 test URLs return valid ProductData with >=3 images, name, price, >=2 bullet points.

tasks.description: Create scripts/promo/product-scraper.py — Python browser_use Agent that navigates to a marketplace URL, extracts ProductData schema (name, brand, price, description, bulletPoints[], images[], rating, reviewCount, topReviews[], category, url), and outputs JSON to stdout.

Create scripts/promo/product-scraper.ts — TypeScript CLI that accepts --url and --job-id flags, calls product-scraper.py via .venv-browser-use python, saves result to workspace/promo-jobs/{jobId}/product.json.
Create scripts/promo/validate-product-scraper.ts — loads a product.json, checks it has name, price, >=3 images, >=2 bulletPoints. Outputs PASS/FAIL.
